cases.sentence: И сейчас, госпожа, я пишу тебе не какое-то ___, но то, которое было у нас с самого начала: будем любить друг друга.
cases.explain: «новое повеление» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

cases.sentence: И сейчас, госпожа, я пишу тебе не какое-то новое повеление, но то, которое было у нас с ___: будем любить друг друга.
cases.explain: «самого начала» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

cases.sentence: Вы с ___ слышали Его повеление, по нему и поступайте.
cases.explain: «самого начала» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

cases.sentence: Много обманщиков вышло в мир, не признающих, что Иисус Христос пришел в ___ .
cases.explain: «человеческом теле» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

cases.sentence: Кто приветствует такого человека, тот становится соучастником в его ___.
cases.explain: «злых делах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
